user.title: Log in to Mijn ENGIE
user.description: Enter the email address and password you use for the ENGIE app or mijn.engie.nl. The password is used once to log in through ENGIE's login server and is not stored; only the resulting session is.

browser.title: Finish the login in your browser
browser.description:
Your account needs a second factor, which only the browser can complete.

1. Open this link and log in:

{url}

2. After login the browser tries to open a page starting with `engie://login/okta/callback?code=` and fails. Copy that whole address from the address bar (or the error page) and paste it below.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in to Mijn ENGIE again
reauth_confirm.description: The stored session for {username} has expired. Enter your password to start a new one.

error.invalid_auth: ENGIE rejected the email address or password.
error.invalid_callback: That address did not contain a valid code. Start again from the link above and copy the full address.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach ENGIE's servers. Try again in a moment.
error.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

abort.already_configured: This ENGIE account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: That login belongs to a different ENGIE customer number than this entry.

data_description.scan_interval_minutes: ENGIE receives smart-meter data once a day, so hourly is plenty.
data_description.include_day_ahead: Dynamic-contract hourly electricity and daily gas prices. Only useful on ENGIE's dynamic contract.
